meta.title: Stitch & Tell
meta.description: Don't just follow a pattern. Make it personal. Turn a photo or your own design into a crochet pattern.
meta.homeTitle: Stitch & Tell — make a crochet pattern your own

brand.name: Stitch & Tell
brand.tagline: Don't just follow a pattern. Make it personal.
brand.taglineSecondary: Your idea. Your pattern. Your craft.

home.howLead: Three calm steps. No jargon, no guesswork.
home.step1Title: Start from a photo or a blank grid
home.step1Body: Upload a picture or place colours by hand. We never invent stitches with AI.
home.step2Title: Tune the size and the palette
home.step2Body: Pick how many stitches wide it should be, and keep the colour count honest.
home.step3Title: Get a chart you can actually crochet
home.step3Body: A square grid, written rows, and symbols that work even without colour.
home.examplesLead: Quiet charts. The colours belong to the maker — not to the interface.
home.exampleSoon: Preview only — the converter comes next.

create.title: Create a pattern
create.lead: Choose how you would like to begin. The converter and the designer will live here next — this is just the doorway.
create.fromPhotoBody: Crop a picture, shrink it to a stitch grid, and reduce it to a handful of colours. All of that will happen in your browser.
create.designBody: Paint stitches on a blank chart. Same pattern format, same written instructions, no photo required.
create.note: Pattern grids are built by code, never by an image-generating AI. Squares stay square. Colour counts stay honest.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.lead: Public patterns will appear here when makers choose to share them. Sharing is always opt-in.
gallery.empty: The gallery is still empty. Create a pattern, then — if you like — publish it.

guides.title: Guides
guides.body: We will write the how-to guides once the tool itself is finished, so the pages match what you actually see on screen.

account.title: Account
account.lead: Sign in will live here — magic link or email code, no password to remember.
account.body: When you are signed in, your settings and private patterns will sync. Until then, preferences stay in this browser.
account.privacyNote: You will be able to download or delete your data from this page.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: A short, honest draft. The full policy will be finished before launch.
privacy.s1Body: As little as possible. Pattern data is small on purpose. Original photos stay in your browser unless you later choose to store one.
privacy.s2Body: Necessary cookies remember your language and settings. Analytics cookies stay off until you accept them on the banner.
privacy.s3Body: You can ask for a copy of your data, or ask us to delete it. Public sharing is never the default.

terms.title: Terms
terms.lead: Placeholder terms for the shell. They will be reviewed before anything is sold or generated at scale.
terms.s1Body: Stitch & Tell helps you turn a photo or a design into a crochet chart. You keep the rights to patterns you create.
terms.s2Body: Do not upload images you do not have the right to use. Do not attempt to bypass weekly limits.
terms.s3Body: The app is under construction. Charts should be double-checked before you spend yarn on them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: These choices follow you around the app. They are saved in this browser until you have an account.
settings.languageHelp: Changes the words in the interface and the URL.
settings.handednessHelp: Only changes how charts and row directions are shown — never the pattern itself.

footer.tagline: Don't just follow a pattern. Make it personal.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use necessary cookies so the site remembers your language and settings. Analytics stay off until you say yes.
cookies.necessaryHelp: Always on — locale, settings, consent choice.
cookies.analyticsHelp: Optional. Helps us see which pages are useful. Off until you accept.

notFound.title: This page is not on the chart
notFound.body: The stitch you were looking for is not here.
